sessions.title: Launcher candidate (Windows first, then Linux)
sessions.where: Beta artifact `launcher-candidate` (all five PRs merged on top of main); bisect with `launcher-pr-<n>` only on KO

rows.title: renderer isolation
rows.check: Home, Settings, Shaders, Highlight and Notifications all load; the progress bar moves during Play; no blank page after going back and forth 3 times.

rows.title: encrypted credentials
rows.check: Log in, quit, reopen: still logged in. Change the language and the RAM, restart: both kept. An old install upgraded: no forced re-login.

rows.title: Electron 45
rows.check: Play reaches the Minecraft title screen; the skin viewer renders; the window resizes and minimizes normally.

rows.title: strict CSP
rows.check: Shop images, Modrinth icons, avatar and skin all show; server status shows. In Beta, Staging: the staging API works (its host must be in connect-src).

rows.title: E2E suite
rows.check: Nothing by hand: CI is green on the candidate. Glance at the report.

sessions.title: Website stack on slot pr1
sessions.where: Slot pr1 = Arffornia_Website#115, the stack tip (it carries #101, #110, #113 and #115)

rows.title: EN/FR
rows.check: Switch EN and FR in the header on 4 pages; the choice survives a reload; no raw messages.* keys; the French reads naturally.

rows.title: Minecraft disclaimer
rows.check: The footer shows "NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT..." in both languages, readable but not shouting.

rows.title: legal pages
rows.check: /legal, /privacy, /terms: publisher TheGostsniperfr and arffornia@gmail.com are right; nothing you would not sign.

rows.title: FAQ
rows.check: /faq "Can I play on a Mac?": the steps match what you expect a player to do.

sessions.title: Website slots pr2 and pr3
sessions.where: One PR per slot; free a slot with `playtest down pr<k>` before the next PR

rows.title: API locale
rows.check: In the beta launcher on Staging, switch to FR: shop and error messages come back in French.

rows.title: Laravel 13 / PHP 8.5
rows.check: Click through home, shop, stages, profile and admin; no 500; the page speed feels the same.

rows.title: chart hardening
rows.check: The agent redeploys the slot twice; the seeded data is still there (migrations no longer wipe). Item textures and avatars load (non-root pod).

rows.title: OAuth state
rows.check: Needs the Arffornia Test Microsoft app. Log in with Microsoft: it works. Open the callback URL a second time: you get "Authentication failed" and no crash.

sessions.title: Test slot (beta launcher, Test slot)
sessions.where: test.arffornia.com:25566, whitelisted; the beta launcher's Test slot environment

rows.title: jar removal
rows.check: Join test.arffornia.com:25566; ComputerCraft computers still work; no FTB Auxilium or RGP; nothing in the log about the removed mods.

rows.title: split config (with Provisioning #35)
rows.check: The server boots with the split config; shop, rewards and progression answer (the staging API); no secret in the client config folder.

rows.title: NetworkPolicies (draft)
